name: org.decentraland.instancing-assets
description: DCL prototype bindings for the Unity Universal Instancer: the tree/detail prototype prefabs, profiles, and shaders authored against org.decentraland.unityuniversalinstancer. It ships assets rather than DCL C# imports, so a single internal placeholder type gives its assembly a compilation unit. Its presence, together with org.decentraland.unityuniversalinstancer, raises GPUI_PRO_PRESENT through DCL.Plugins.asmdef's versionDefines mapping, which gates the tree-instancing call sites.
